cell_aggregation.reduction: top2 (mean of the two largest byte logits in the cell)

forward: see segarecomp_ml_region_z80_gen2_train.build_model (D512HP: stride-4 dilated residual context path (1,2,4,8,16,32), local conv path, 1x1 fuse, 1x1 head)

input_schema.ensemble: arithmetic mean of the three per-byte logits
input_schema.output: one float32 logit per image byte
input_schema.tokens: image bytes 0..255; PAD token 256 outside the image

weights_sha256_algorithm: per model in seed order, per tensor sorted by name: name bytes then raw little-endian float32 bytes
